projects.title: Querylytics AI
projects.summary: An AI-powered private analytics platform that allows users to upload datasets and generate insights through natural language conversations.
projects.challenge: Create a secure analytics workflow without exposing sensitive data directly to LLMs.
projects.delivery: Built a secure architecture using React, FastAPI, Gemini AI, LangChain, ChromaDB, and Plotly for intelligent analytics and visualizations.
projects.impact: Demonstrated how AI can simplify data exploration while maintaining privacy and scalable architecture.

projects.title: Self-Driving Car Environment Perception
projects.summary: An AI-powered environment perception system for autonomous vehicles using computer vision and deep learning techniques on the KITTI dataset.
projects.challenge: Build a reliable perception pipeline capable of identifying road objects, understanding driving environments, and improving detection accuracy using transfer learning.
projects.delivery: Implemented object detection and semantic segmentation workflows using YOLOv26 and ResNet-50 with transfer learning on the KITTI 4K dataset.
projects.impact: Achieved 87% model accuracy while improving object recognition and scene understanding for autonomous driving environments.
